business_summary: OCI International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides asset management services in Hong Kong. It operates through Asset Management, Investment and Financial Advisory Services, Underwriting and Placing of Securities, Securities Trading and Investments, and Trading of Wine and Beverage segments. The company offers direct investments; private equity and bond fund management; private equity and fixed income investments; and cross-border merger and acquisition, pre-IPO, mezzanine, and listed securities investment and trading services. It also provides investment funds; investment and financial advisory; and securities underwriting and placing services. In addition, the company engages in the investment and trading of fine wine and other liqueurs and spirits. The company was formerly known as Dragonite International Limited and changed its name to OCI International Holdings Limited in June 2017. OCI International Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Hong Kong, Hong Kong.
